narrative.headline: 2018 Honda Odyssey: electrical complaints lead, but the safety systems carry the serious outcomes
narrative.summary: Owners filed 914 complaints with NHTSA. The electrical system is the most reported area at 26%, followed by the engine and the forward collision avoidance system (19% each) and the power train (17%). Most of the serious harm sits with the driver-assist features: forward collision avoidance accounts for the only 3 reported deaths, plus 4 crashes and 3 injuries, so check how the adaptive cruise and braking aids behave on a test drive.
